node.title: KoalaBear aligned-negative literal-assignment coverage
node.closure: all twelve literal aligned-negative assignments are excluded on a complete two-chart reconstruction cover
node.statement: In the literal frame J_0={2,1/2,b,1/b}, directly reconstruct every one of the eight fixed-moving and four moving-moving aligned-negative assignments on the complementary charts c+d nonzero and c+d=0. Factoring the unused reconstruction consistency equation leaves one genuine component in each fixed-moving cell and two in each moving-moving cell after determinant units are removed. On all 32 components, the monic q-slice mismatch satisfies m_0=(cd-1)(cd+1)/(c^2d^2). Admissibility forces cd=-1; the generic chart then satisfies m_1-m_3=4(c^2-1)/c, while the sum-zero chart directly gives c^2=1. Both contradict the named open. Hence the aligned-negative literal residual is empty without endpoint covariance.
